extra_vocab.en: sweet food that you eat at the end of a meal
extra_vocab.note: 多益餐廳、宴會與商務聚餐情境常見，指餐後的甜點。常出現在 dessert menu、for dessert 這類說法。

example.en: The cafe sells fresh desserts made by a local baker.
example.zh: 這家咖啡店賣當地烘焙師做的新鮮甜點。

example.en: Could we see the dessert menu before we order coffee?
example.zh: 我們點咖啡前，可以看一下甜點菜單嗎？

example.en: We had chocolate cake for dessert after the business dinner.
example.zh: 商務晚餐後，我們吃巧克力蛋糕當甜點。

example.en: Clients often order dessert after a long business meal.
example.zh: 客戶在長時間的商務餐後常會點甜點。

examples.en: The restaurant is famous for its fresh fruit desserts.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳以新鮮水果甜點聞名。

examples.en: Dessert will be served after the speeches end.
examples.zh: 致詞結束後會供應甜點。

examples.en: The set lunch includes a drink and a small dessert.
examples.zh: 這份午間套餐包含一杯飲料和一份小甜點。

confusable.diff: 拼法只差一個 s；desert 是「沙漠」，也可當動詞「拋棄」。
confusable.usage: dessert 有兩個 s，重音在第二音節 /dɪˈzɜːrt/；名詞 desert（沙漠）重音在第一音節 /ˈdezərt/。

example.en: The company plans to build a solar farm in the desert.
example.zh: 這家公司計畫在沙漠裡建一座太陽能發電場。

example.en: We shared an appetizer while we waited for the main dish.
example.zh: 等主菜的時候，我們分食了一份開胃菜。

example.en: Food and beverages are free at the company party.
example.zh: 公司派對的食物和飲料都免費。

example.en: Please bring a snack for the long train ride.
example.zh: 搭長途火車請帶點心。

extra_vocab.zh: 摧毀、重創；使極度震驚難過
extra_vocab.en: to damage something very badly, or to make someone feel very sad
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於天災、經濟與新聞報導，指造成嚴重破壞；也可指消息讓人非常難過。常用被動 be devastated by，也常見形容詞 devastating。

example.en: A big storm devastates many coastal towns almost every year.
example.zh: 大型風暴幾乎每年都重創許多海岸城鎮。

example.en: The fire devastated the factory and stopped all production.
example.zh: 這場火災重創了工廠，所有生產都停擺。

example.en: Staff were devastated by the news of the closing.
example.zh: 員工對倒閉的消息感到極度難過。

example.en: The storm had a devastating effect on local tourism.
example.zh: 這場風暴對當地觀光造成毀滅性的影響。

example.en: Many small shops were devastated by the flood.
example.zh: 許多小商店被洪水重創。

example.en: A long drought could devastate the local farming economy.
example.zh: 長期乾旱可能重創當地的農業經濟。

example.en: The company suffered a devastating loss last quarter.
example.zh: 這家公司上一季遭受毀滅性的虧損。

examples.en: The flood could devastate small businesses in the area.
examples.zh: 洪水可能重創這個地區的小型企業。

examples.en: The news of the factory closing devastated the workers.
examples.zh: 工廠關閉的消息讓員工極度難過。

examples.en: She was devastated when the client canceled the contract.
examples.zh: 客戶取消合約時，她非常難過。

similar.diff: destroy 是「毀掉」，語氣一般；devastate 強調「大範圍的嚴重破壞」。

example.en: The fire destroyed most of the old warehouse.
example.zh: 這場火燒毀了大部分的舊倉庫。

similar.diff: ruin 是「毀壞、搞砸」，也可用在計畫或心情；devastate 多指重大災難。

example.en: One mistake can ruin a good business plan.
example.zh: 一個錯誤就可能毀掉一份好的營運計畫。

example.en: The storm caused serious damage to the roof.
example.zh: 風暴對屋頂造成嚴重損害。

example.en: The company has a plan for any natural disaster.
example.zh: 公司對任何天災都有應變計畫。

example.en: The loss of the main client hurt our sales.
example.zh: 失去主要客戶讓我們的業績受創。

derived.link: devastate + -ion，動詞變名詞，像 educate → education

senses.en: to damage a place or business very badly
senses.distinguish: 主詞是 flood、fire、storm、crisis 這類事件時，指大規模破壞。

example.en: The storm devastated farms across the whole region last spring.
example.zh: 去年春天的風暴重創了整個地區的農場。

senses.en: to make someone feel very sad and shocked
senses.distinguish: 受詞是人，或用被動 be devastated 時，指心情上的打擊。

example.en: The sudden layoffs devastated many long-time employees.
example.zh: 突然的裁員讓許多資深員工大受打擊。

extra_vocab.en: a simple drawing that shows how something works or how parts fit together
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於使用說明書、簡報與會議，說明結構、流程或組裝方式。和 chart 不同，diagram 偏向「示意圖」，不是數據統計圖。

example.en: The training manual uses many diagrams to explain each step.
example.zh: 這本訓練手冊用許多圖解說明每個步驟。

example.en: Can you draw a diagram to explain the new process?
example.zh: 你可以畫張示意圖說明新的流程嗎？

example.en: Follow the diagram to assemble the desk safely.
example.zh: 請照著圖解安全地組裝這張桌子。

example.en: Here is a diagram of our new office layout.
example.zh: 這是我們新辦公室配置的示意圖。

examples.en: The diagram shows how the parts fit together.
examples.zh: 這張圖解顯示各個零件如何組合。

examples.en: The manual includes a diagram of the printer's inside.
examples.zh: 說明書裡附有印表機內部的示意圖。

examples.en: The manager used a simple diagram to explain the budget.
examples.zh: 經理用一張簡單的圖解說明預算。

confusable.diff: 字尾同樣是 -gram，拼法相近；program 是「計畫、節目、程式」。

example.en: The training program starts next Monday morning.
example.zh: 這個訓練計畫下週一早上開始。

similar.diff: chart 多指統計或數據圖表；diagram 多指結構、流程的示意圖。

example.en: The chart shows that sales rose sharply in March.
example.zh: 圖表顯示三月銷售額大幅上升。

similar.diff: graph 是用線或長條表示數字變化的圖；diagram 不一定有數字。

example.en: The graph shows our monthly sales for the past year.
example.zh: 這張圖顯示我們過去一年的每月銷售額。

example.en: Please add a chart to the end of the report.
example.zh: 請在報告最後加上一張圖表。

example.en: The graph on page five is hard to read.
example.zh: 第五頁的統計圖很難看懂。

example.en: Each page of the guide has a color illustration.
example.zh: 指南的每一頁都有彩色插圖。

extra_vocab.en: a person whose job is to guard or open the door of a hotel or building
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於飯店、公寓大樓與活動會場，指在門口迎接客人、協助搬行李或代收包裹的人。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: doorman 的複數是不規則的 doormen，不是 doormans。

example.en: Two doormen stand at the hotel entrance every evening.
example.zh: 每天晚上有兩位門衛站在飯店入口。

example.en: The hotel doorman called a taxi for our guests.
example.zh: 飯店門衛幫我們的客人叫了計程車。

example.en: If you lose your key, ask the doorman for help.
example.zh: 如果你弄丟鑰匙，請找門房幫忙。

example.en: Please leave the package with the doorman downstairs.
example.zh: 請把包裹交給樓下的門房。

examples.en: The doorman helped us with our heavy bags.
examples.zh: 門衛幫我們提沉重的行李。

examples.en: The doorman signs for every delivery that arrives at the building.
examples.zh: 門房會為每件送到大樓的貨物簽收。

examples.en: A doorman checks every guest's invitation at the entrance.
examples.zh: 門衛在入口檢查每位賓客的邀請函。

similar.diff: porter 主要是搬運行李的人；doorman 主要負責門口的迎接與安全。

example.en: The porter carried our luggage up to the room.
example.zh: 行李員把我們的行李搬到房間。

similar.diff: security guard 的重點是保安與巡查；doorman 還會迎接客人、叫車。

example.en: A security guard checks visitors at the front gate.
example.zh: 保全人員在大門口檢查訪客。

example.en: The guard locks the building at ten every night.
example.zh: 警衛每晚十點鎖上大樓。

example.en: The receptionist will give you a visitor badge.
example.zh: 接待人員會給你一張訪客證。

example.en: Our porter can take your bags to the car.
example.zh: 我們的行李員可以幫你把行李送到車上。

extra_vocab.en: a problem that makes something less good
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於產品評價、方案比較與會議討論，語氣中性偏正式，常和 advantage、benefit 成對出現。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 常用句型是 a drawback of / to + 名詞，或 a drawback is that + 子句。

example.en: Each option has some drawbacks, so we need more time.
example.zh: 每個選項都有一些缺點，所以我們需要更多時間。

example.en: A major drawback of this machine is its high price.
example.zh: 這台機器的主要缺點是價格太高。

example.en: We should weigh the drawbacks before we sign the contract.
example.zh: 簽約前我們應該衡量缺點。

example.en: The drawback of working from home is feeling alone.
example.zh: 在家工作的缺點是會覺得孤單。

examples.en: The only drawback of this plan is the high cost.
examples.zh: 這個計畫唯一的缺點是成本很高。

examples.en: This phone has one drawback: the battery runs out quickly.
examples.zh: 這支手機有個缺點：電池很快就沒電。

examples.en: Let's discuss the advantages and drawbacks of moving the office.
examples.zh: 讓我們討論搬遷辦公室的優點和缺點。

confusable.diff: setback 是「挫折、延誤」，指進度受阻；drawback 是「缺點」。

example.en: The delay was a setback for our product launch.
example.zh: 這次延誤是我們產品上市的一個挫折。

similar.diff: disadvantage 較正式，是 advantage 的反義字；drawback 較口語。

example.en: Poor location is a big disadvantage for a new store.
example.zh: 地點不佳對新店來說是很大的不利條件。

similar.diff: downside 較口語，常指一件好事附帶的壞處。

example.en: The downside of this plan is that it takes longer.
example.zh: 這個計畫的壞處是需要更長的時間。

example.en: Low cost is the main advantage of this supplier.
example.zh: 低成本是這家供應商的主要優點。

example.en: Flexible hours are a big benefit of this job.
example.zh: 彈性工時是這份工作的一大好處。

example.en: There is a small risk of delay in shipping.
example.zh: 運送有一點延誤的風險。

extra_vocab.en: a round instrument you hit to make sound, or a large round container
extra_vocab.note: 多益中以「鼓」（活動、樂團）和「圓桶」（倉庫、運輸的油桶）為主；動詞片語 drum up（招攬、拉攏）也常見於行銷情境。

example.en: The band brought two drums to the company party.
example.zh: 樂團帶了兩面鼓到公司派對。

example.en: She drummed up new clients by calling old customers.
example.zh: 她打電話給老顧客來招攬新客戶。

example.en: He was drumming on the table while he waited.
example.zh: 他一邊等一邊用手敲桌子。

example.en: Several oil drums were stored behind the warehouse.
example.zh: 倉庫後面存放了幾個油桶。

example.en: We held a free event to drum up new business.
example.zh: 我們舉辦免費活動來招攬新生意。

example.en: He plays the drum in a band on weekends.
example.zh: 他週末在樂團裡打鼓。

examples.en: The band's drum could be heard from outside the hall.
examples.zh: 從會場外面就聽得到樂團的鼓聲。

examples.en: Each drum holds about two hundred liters of oil.
examples.zh: 每個圓桶大約裝兩百公升的油。

examples.en: A good ad can drum up support for a new product.
examples.zh: 好的廣告能為新產品拉攏支持。

confusable.diff: 拼法和發音接近；drug 是「藥物」。

example.en: The company tests every new drug before selling it.
example.zh: 這家公司在販售前會測試每一種新藥。

similar.diff: barrel 偏指木桶或大桶（如酒桶）；drum 偏指金屬圓桶。

example.en: The wine is stored in wooden barrels.
example.zh: 這款酒存放在木桶裡。

example.en: A local band will play at our anniversary party.
example.zh: 一個本地樂團會在我們的週年派對演奏。

example.en: Oil is sold by the barrel on the world market.
example.zh: 世界市場上的石油是以桶計價販售。

derived.link: drum + -er，打鼓的人，像 singer、player（m 要雙寫）

example.en: The factory ships the paint in steel drums.
example.zh: 工廠用鋼製圓桶運送油漆。

example.en: We need to drum up more interest in the new service.
example.zh: 我們需要為新服務拉攏更多興趣。

senses.en: a round instrument that you hit to make music
senses.distinguish: 和 band、play、music 一起出現時，指樂器。

example.en: The school band bought a new drum for the concert.
example.zh: 學校樂隊為演奏會買了一面新鼓。

senses.en: a large round container for oil or other liquids
senses.distinguish: 和 oil、steel、store、ship 一起出現時，指金屬圓桶。

example.en: Please move the empty drum to the loading area.
example.zh: 請把空桶搬到裝貨區。

extra_vocab.en: a long period of time with little or no rain
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於新聞、農業與供水報導，說明長期缺雨對收成、物價或用水的影響。發音注意：gh 不發音。

example.en: Repeated droughts have changed how farmers plan each season.
example.zh: 反覆的乾旱改變了農民規劃每個季節的方式。

example.en: A severe drought has pushed up food prices this year.
example.zh: 嚴重的乾旱讓今年的食品價格上漲。

example.en: Many farms in the region suffer from drought every summer.
example.zh: 這個地區許多農場每年夏天都受乾旱所苦。

example.en: Drought conditions forced the factory to use less water.
example.zh: 乾旱狀況迫使工廠減少用水。

examples.en: The long drought reduced this year's rice harvest.
examples.zh: 長期乾旱減少了今年的稻米收成。

examples.en: The city asked residents to save water during the drought.
examples.zh: 市政府要求居民在乾旱期間節約用水。

examples.en: Farmers can buy insurance against losses from drought.
examples.zh: 農民可以購買保險，以防乾旱造成損失。

similar.diff: dry spell 指「一段缺雨的時期」，時間較短、語氣較口語；drought 較嚴重。

example.en: A dry spell in July hurt the corn crop.
example.zh: 七月的一段缺雨期傷害了玉米作物。

example.en: The flood closed the main road for two days.
example.zh: 洪水讓主要道路封閉了兩天。

example.en: The drought caused a shortage of fresh vegetables.
example.zh: 乾旱造成新鮮蔬菜短缺。

example.en: This year's harvest was smaller than we expected.
example.zh: 今年的收成比我們預期的少。

extra_vocab.en: to make an exact copy of something, or to do the same thing again
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於辦公室文書與系統資料，如重複的檔案、發票或工作（duplicate effort）。名詞與形容詞指「複本、重複的」，動詞指「複製、重複做」。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 發音不同：動詞結尾是 /-keɪt/（/ˈduːplɪkeɪt/），名詞與形容詞結尾是 /-kət/（/ˈduːplɪkət/）。

forms.label: 第三人稱單數／複數
forms.zh: 複製（第三人稱單數）；複本（複數）

example.en: The software automatically duplicates every file at night.
example.zh: 這套軟體每晚自動複製所有檔案。

example.en: Someone duplicated the order by mistake yesterday.
example.zh: 昨天有人不小心重複下了訂單。

example.en: We are duplicating the files before the system update.
example.zh: 系統更新前，我們正在複製檔案。

example.en: Please fill out this application form in duplicate before Friday.
example.zh: 請在星期五前填好這份申請表一式兩份。

example.en: Sharing files helps us avoid duplicate efforts across teams.
example.zh: 共享檔案能幫我們避免各組做重複的工作。

example.en: I asked the manager for a duplicate key to the storeroom.
example.zh: 我向經理要了一把倉庫的備用鑰匙。

examples.en: Please do not duplicate this file without permission.
examples.zh: 未經許可請勿複製這份檔案。

examples.en: The system found a duplicate invoice in last month's records.
examples.zh: 系統在上個月的紀錄中發現一張重複的發票。

examples.en: Let's not duplicate the work that Tom has already done.
examples.zh: 我們不要重複湯姆已經做完的工作。

similar.diff: copy 是一般的「複製、影印」；duplicate 強調做出一模一樣的另一份。

example.en: Please make a copy of the signed contract.
example.zh: 請影印一份已簽名的合約。

similar.diff: repeat 是「重複做同一件事」；duplicate 常指不必要的重複。

example.en: Please do not repeat the same mistake in the report.
example.zh: 請不要在報告裡重複同樣的錯誤。

example.en: Keep a copy of the receipt for your records.
example.zh: 請保留一份收據影本做紀錄。

example.en: Please bring the original and one copy to the interview.
example.zh: 請帶原件和一份影本來面試。

example.en: Please check the double entry in the account book.
example.zh: 請檢查帳簿裡重複登錄的項目。

derived.link: duplicate + -ion，動詞變名詞，像 educate → education

example.en: Our new system can duplicate large files in seconds.
example.zh: 我們的新系統可以在幾秒內複製大型檔案。

example.en: Please keep a duplicate of the contract in your file.
example.zh: 請在你的檔案中保留一份合約副本。

example.en: We received a duplicate bill for the same service.
example.zh: 我們收到一張同一項服務的重複帳單。
